A RADIANT MASTER ARTISAN!
Sep 2026 • Family
A DAUGHTER'S JOYFUL LETTER: CELEBRATING MY MOTHER – A RADIANT MASTER ARTISAN!

Mom, today I am writing this to proudly introduce my superstar mother to the whole world!

I am the youngest daughter of Artisan Nguyen Thi Thuong – the sweet woman who always smiles warmly next to the glowing hearth of Co Hai Thuong 1970.

For decades, watching Mom craft each pastry with pure, unconditional love, I promised myself I would use my youth and digital tools to bring her lifetime legacy into the light. Today, my heart is bursting with joy because Mom's brilliant 56-year journey has officially reached its ultimate pinnacle! My mother now stands in a completely new realm: A revered Master Artisan and a celebrated Custodian of Vietnamese Cultural Heritage.

Seeing Mom smile so happily while holding her framed national feature makes me incredibly proud! From being honored among the Top 32 Historic Traditional Heritage Brands by MoMo, to being featured in The Vietnam Artisan Craft Magazine signed by the Editor-in-Chief, and endorsed by Nguoi Dua Tin... The whole country is celebrating her 100% preservative-free, handmade Bánh Bèo and Bánh Lọc. You have done something truly extraordinary, Mom!

* A Traditional Treasure for Soulful Connoisseurs:
Mom's pastries are legendary, but they are not meant for the fast-paced, mass-produced world. Every single bite carries her craftsmanship, dedication, and vibrant zest for life. It is an exclusive culinary experience reserved strictly for true connoisseurs—those who deeply revere cultural roots. Savoring her creations is a shared moment of celebration, enjoying a culinary masterpiece that shines brightly in the modern world.

* A Generous Smile Amidst Soaring Inflation:
People often wonder: “With inflation and costs skyrocketing everywhere, why has Co Hai Thuong firmly kept each pastry at just 2,000 to 3,000 VND for so long?” Mom just smiles gently and says she does not create for profit, but purely for the joy of preserving Vietnamese culture. She wants to ensure that no matter how unstable the economy gets, everyone—from hardworking locals to international travelers—can experience history with absolute happiness. That humble price is her beautiful gift to the world, and I could not be more proud of her generous heart!

* Spreading Warmth and Support to the Next Generation:
Living right next to the University Campus, Mom has always held a special place in her heart for the hardworking students studying late into the night. Her maternal love inspired us to launch the "Campus Ambassador" program. This is how I digitalized her wish, turning our heritage brand into a platform to empower resilient students with flexible income opportunities right on campus. When you receive fresh dumplings from our dynamic Ambassadors like Hanh Chau (Dormitory Area B), you are receiving the immense warmth and positive energy that Mom pours into her work.

Mom, please stay healthy, joyful, and continue to be my strongest anchor of happiness! I will dedicate my youth to protecting, expanding, and sharing this magnificent foundation with the world.

Thank you for being the most wonderful mother and Master Artisan in my life!
